items.author: KeithSmithNBA
items.body_excerpt:
Hawks are taking on about $2.4M by acquiring Dorian Finney-Smith for Buddy Hield and Ryan Nembhard.

Atlanta will be about $1.4M under the luxury tax with 15 players on standard contracts.

Hornets will have 18 players on standard deals, necessitating three waivers.
